en: Welcome to Pal Park's gate! The park itself is far away in Sinnoh, but we can take you straight there.
text: Bine ai venit la poarta Pal Park! Parcul e departe, în Sinnoh, dar te putem duce direct acolo.

en: Would you like to go to Pal Park?
text: Vrei să mergi la Pal Park?

en: Right this way, please. Mind the step!
text: Pe aici, te rog. Ai grijă la treaptă!

en: {player} was shown through the gate on the long way to Pal Park...
text: {player} a fost condus prin poartă pe drumul lung spre Pal Park...

en: Whenever you're ready. The park's Pokémon aren't going anywhere.
text: Oricând ești gata. Pokémonii din parc nu pleacă nicăieri.

en: Pal Park is a place for Pokémon from far away. Only a Trainer with the National Pokédex may go through.
text: Pal Park e un loc pentru Pokémoni de departe. Doar un Antrenor cu Pokédex-ul Național poate trece.
